levelDefinitions.L1: 资料导航：可检索已收录来源并显示覆盖缺口；不自动给出产品特定适用性或税额。
levelDefinitions.L2: 结构化初筛：具有产品特征追问、条件规则、行动材料清单和HS候选；金额测算可因税率或措施数据不足而阻断。
levelDefinitions.L3: 可复算路径：在L2基础上，普通交易情景的税基、税率和法定分项已有版本化官方依据及回归测试；仍不等于正式合规或最终归类。

levelDefinitionsEn.L1: Source navigation: search indexed sources and view coverage gaps; no product-specific applicability conclusion or tax amount is generated.
levelDefinitionsEn.L2: Structured screening: product-feature questions, conditional rules, action/material lists and HS candidates are available; tax totals may be withheld when rates or measures are incomplete.
levelDefinitionsEn.L3: Reproducible path: includes L2 plus versioned official support and regression checks for the tax base, rates and statutory items in a standard transaction; it is not formal compliance or final classification.
